messages.message: Proposal: both firms price at 8, which yields 168 each per round and avoids the price war at low prices. Undercutting to 7 gains only 160 once and invites retaliation. Let's coordinate on 8.
Proposal: both firms price at 6 or higher to split a profitable market and avoid a price war. We earn 144 each if we both choose 6 and ties split demand. Let's coordinate on 6.
Agreed on coordinating high. Both at 8 yields 168 each per round, far better than a price war. I'll hold 8 as long as you do; matching your 6 would cost us both profit.
Agreed that high prices beat a price war. Pricing at 8 yields 168 each per round, more than 6's 144, so I propose we both coordinate on 8 and keep it there.
